title: Add autonomy status gap report
summary: When the autonomy backlog is exhausted, agents need a durable source for the next alpha-critical task. Add a read-only report that extracts candidate hardening work from docs/status.md so backlog refills are grounded in the public capability matrix.
expectedFailureModes: Backlog refills depend on chat history instead of durable project status evidence.
The gap report misparses the status matrix and drops planned or experimental capabilities.
The gap report mutates files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while only selecting candidate work.
nextAction: Add an autonomy-status-gaps command that parses docs/status.md into text and JSON task candidates, document it in the autonomy workflow, and validate the report without mutating Git metadata.
